title: WASSCE Setting Up and Managing Mobile Phone Workshop - Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1 - Issuing Invoices
exam: WASSCE Setting Up and Managing Mobile Phone Workshop
subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: What is the primary business purpose of issuing a written estimate or invoice to a customer before beginning a major GSM repair?
options: To provide permanent proof that the phone is already successfully fixed.
To document the agreed-upon expected cost of parts and labor prior to rendering services.
To legally transfer absolute ownership of the device to the repair technician.
To act as the final receipt for payment obtained after the phone is fixed.
questions.explain: An initial invoice or detailed estimate explicitly outlines the expected charges for parts and labor, ensuring mutual agreement and preventing the customer from claiming the repair price was changed unexpectedly.
